effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` USDC to the vault, which supplies it to Morpho Blue markets.
The vault mints shares (bbUSDC) to `receiver`; the number is computed from the vault's total assets and supply (rounded down), with no minimum set in calldata.
Before the deposit, the vault mints fee shares to its fee recipient, which sets the share price the signer gets.
formats.shown: Intent 'Deposit' with the USDC amount, a constant 'Share ticker: bbUSDC' and the receiver of the shares.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many bbUSDC shares the receiver gets; the vault price decides it.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. Case 0: the signer receives 266.261190581786053577 bbUSDC, and the screen shows only 'Share ticker: bbUSDC'. The blind reader wrote 'bbUSDC shares, amount not shown'.
findings.fix: No calldata value holds the share amount. Rename the 'Share ticker' field to 'Shares received (amount set by vault price)' so the signer knows why no amount is shown.

findings.title: deposit intent 'Deposit' names no asset or vault, and there is no sentence.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit format: `"intent": "Deposit"`, no interpolatedIntent. The amount and receiver appear only in the fields.
findings.fix: Set intent to 'Deposit USDC into bbUSDC vault' and add interpolatedIntent 'Deposit {assets} into bbUSDC vault for {receiver}'.

cases.notes: The screen shows USDC out with the correct amount. bbUSDC in shows the asset and the receiver but no amount; the reader saw that the amount was missing.

effects: The vault mints exactly `shares` bbUSDC to `receiver`.
The signer pays USDC equal to the shares converted at the current vault price (rounded up). This amount is computed on chain and only the signer's allowance caps it.
Before the mint, the vault mints fee shares to its fee recipient, which sets the price.
formats.shown: Intent 'Mint' with 'Deposit asset: USDC' (no amount), the exact shares to mint and the receiver of the shares.

findings.title: mint does not show how much USDC leaves the signer; the vault price sets it, with no calldata cap.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); _deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, assets, shares);`. Descriptor: `{"label": "Deposit asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}` shows only 'USDC'.
findings.fix: Relabel the field to 'Pay with USDC (amount set by vault price)'.

findings.title: mint intent 'Mint' does not say the signer pays USDC for the shares.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint format: `"intent": "Mint"`. The code takes USDC from the caller in `_deposit`. A non-expert may read 'Mint' as a free mint.
findings.fix: Set intent to 'Buy bbUSDC vault shares with USDC' and add interpolatedIntent 'Mint {shares} for {receiver}, paid in USDC'.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault sends exactly `assets` USDC to `receiver`, after it takes the USDC from Morpho Blue markets.
The vault burns shares from `owner`, computed from the vault price (rounded up), with no maximum set in calldata.
If the caller is not `owner`, the call spends the owner's bbUSDC allowance to the caller by that number of shares.
formats.shown: Intent 'Withdraw' with 'Withdraw exactly' and the USDC amount, the receiver and the owner.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many bbUSDC shares the vault burns from the owner.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);`. No field shows the shares, and calldata holds no maximum.
findings.fix: No calldata value holds it. Optionally add a note to the owner label: 'Owner (shares burned at vault price)'.

findings.title: withdraw intent 'Withdraw' names no asset or vault, and there is no sentence.
findings.fix: Set intent to 'Withdraw USDC from bbUSDC vault' and add interpolatedIntent 'Withdraw {assets} to {receiver}'.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` bbUSDC from `owner` (spending the caller's allowance if the caller is not the owner).
The vault sends USDC to `receiver`, converted at the vault price (rounded down), with no minimum set in calldata.
Before the redeem, the vault mints fee shares to its fee recipient, which sets the price.
formats.shown: Intent 'Redeem' with the bbUSDC shares to redeem, the receiver and the owner. Nothing names the asset that is paid out.

findings.title: redeem never names USDC as the asset paid out, unlike the deposit and mint formats.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.redeem → `_withdraw(_msgSender(), receiver, owner, assets, shares)` sends USDC to receiver. Case 1: the signer receives 300.953709 USDC. The screen has only 'Shares to redeem', 'To' and 'Owner'. The reader wrote 'likely USDC… exact amount not shown'.
findings.fix: Add `{"label": "Receive", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}` and set intent to 'Redeem bbUSDC for USDC'.

findings.title: redeem does not show the USDC amount received; the vault price sets it, with no minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. Case 1: 300.953709 USDC arrives, and no amount is on the screen.
findings.fix: No calldata value holds the amount. A label such as 'Receive USDC (amount set by vault price)' explains why it is missing.

findings.title: redeem intent 'Redeem' names neither the shares nor the asset received, and there is no sentence.

cases.notes: The screen shows the bbUSDC burn with the exact amount. USDC in is not shown at all; the reader guessed USDC but got no amount.
